The Sunderland antisocial behaviour hotspots according to latest police data

By Neil Fatkin
Published 11th Oct 2026, 11:33 BST

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 0:45
Instaread

Northumbria Police has published its crime data for Sunderland for the month of August including the parts of the city with the highest number of reported incidents of antisocial behaviour (ASB).

ASB is classed as actions that cause harassment, alarm, or distress to others.

All incidents are said to have taken place “in or near” named locations.

Check out the ASB hotspots in Sunderland according the latest Northumbria Police data.
